svg.text: pad-ble v1 on the breadboard: where everything goes

The devkit's pin labels are MEASURED off the board (the bench eye cannot read that silkscreen). It straddles the channel, so only rows A and J are reachable in its columns. Every wire is read out of the schematic.
BLE only: the USB port is serial and JTAG
the plug half of the cable
4 numbered jumpers, and 5 short wires to the rails
Every one of these is read out of the schematic. Red stubs go to the nearest + rail, blue stubs to the nearest - rail; they are not numbered because they are all the same instruction.
PAD1_D0, the green lead: J1 D0 to R1 col 26 row H
PAD1_D0, the green lead: R1 col 26 row H to U1 pin marked 6 (col 50 row J)
PAD_CLK, the blue lead: J1 CLK to U1 pin marked 3 (col 42 row J)
PAD_LATCH, the black lead: J1 OUT0 to U1 pin marked 2 (col 43 row J)
